summary: Feed s079_single is degraded: 98.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the NDR tolerance of 90%. All other visibility checks (duplicates, VLAN, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Almost all traffic (98.5%) is TLS/encrypted and is being forwarded as-is with no decryption or cleartext feed from the packet broker. NDR tolerates up to 90% encrypted, so this exceeds its design point.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep inspection, JA3/JA4, file extraction and anomaly detection. With only ciphertext visible, detection coverage is severely blinded and most threats inside encrypted sessions will be missed.

recommended_fix.why: Provide selective decryption via a compliant TLS visibility/decryption zone or forward already-decrypted traffic (e.g., from proxy/NGFW) to the NDR. This restores cleartext payload for inspection while respecting privacy/policy controls for excluded categories.
